jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
jobs.desc:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year

All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. jobs.title: Head of Business Operations — Business
jobs.desc: The Role Taptap send is building a Business product, leveraging the best-in-class cross-border payment network we have built. This is a new product line we’re building from the ground up and we are looking for a hungry, hands-on generalist to build and scale the operations behind it. You will own high impact, high urgency, needle-moving goals on a new and fast growing product in an established start up. Taptap Send Business is early and growing fast. Businesses are already using us to pay people and suppliers across emerging markets, and we are launching a wider set of products and geographies. Every launch is a new promise to a business customer whose payroll, suppliers and cash flow depend on us getting it right. This role reports to the Director of Business Operations and owns the service our business customers get. You will be given high agency and high autonomy, working across Product, Data, Engineering and Compliance to build and run best-in-class support for a product line that is growing fast. The outcome you will drive Business customer retention — build an AI native account management support that is an order of magnitude better than anything on the market. A service excellence our BPO partners deliver to , consistently, as volume and product complexity increase. Launch readiness — every new product and geography requires specific support, you build it and run it. Insight to build a Product businesses love — you’re the closest to what business customers actually ask, you quantify it and get it into the roadmap. Cost of support — own the budget for support and make it more efficient with scale. Responsibilities Design, build and run best-in-class support for the Business product, end to end Identify unhappy paths, build and automate solutions and work with product to fix at scale Design, build and maintain AI-powered workflows and automations that reduce manual effort, improve retention and scale Operations effectively Take operational functions and processes from 0 to 1, then 1 to 100 Set the standard our BPO partners are held to — playbooks, QA, KPIs — and hold the performance bar high Structure complex and ambiguous problems by conducting ad hoc analysis Act as Product Ops for the Business line: turn what customers tell us into evidenced product priorities, and get them built Work across highly technical and specialised product, engineering and data colleagues to deliver an experience business customers stay for Own support for each new launch, from readiness through to a steady, automated state Requirements 5-7+ years of high-performing experience in a fast pace, analytical environment B2B account management, customer success or business operations for a business/SME product is what we are looking for , you know what business customers expect and what it takes to deliver it You are looking for a role where you can directly drive the impact, where you are the owner and have autonomy to make decisions and drive outcomes You take ownership, are dependable, and do the hard things to make things work. You own the problems end-to-end and constantly ship improvements Comfortable using SQL to drive decisions daily Willingness to build and iterate on AI-powered workflows and automations No task too small, willingness to dive in and sweat the details regardless of the tool or problem Instinct to add 'just enough' process to scale without cumbersome bureaucracy Comfortable in a regulated, 24/7 business where the stakes for the customer are real London, office based How we work A BizOps role at Taptap Send is a super Individual Contributor . For your topic you are the single threaded owner, the analyst, the product manager, the engineer and the operations lead. In practice you don’t wait for others, you leverage AI to get things done and build what drives the outcome you seek. This is not a coordination role, and it is not a strategy-deck role. If your best work has been influencing other teams to build things, this will be a frustrating job. If you have been waiting for a role where you are simply allowed to go and fix it, this is that role. This role is a launchpad — previous BizOps hires have gone on to lead functions and launch products. About Us We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services. Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features. We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation . Here’s a little more: Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly ( $300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world) Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word Taptap Values Impact first Team next Accept reality Propose solutions Win with grit Be proactively candid, with yourself and others Love the particular Own it Create positive energy Maybe, even have fun Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. jobs.title: Product Associate
jobs.desc: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. About the role We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially. As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it. This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech. What you'll be doing Product analytics insight Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey Unit economics commercial thinking Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money Growth product strategy Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume,
